strengths: Every one of the 120 required cells exists in fixed order; missing data are null rather than zero or guessed values.
Every numeric cell carries numerator, denominator, workload/checkpoint/sequence, operator/resource scope, evidence class, source path/SHA/pointer, and an explicit non-system admission boundary.
M472 absolute counters are retained only as official external support-tile evidence; the external 2.459x ratio is absent.
M510 decoder correction is a first-class blocker, so the old 620M-class included-scope envelope cannot silently become a full-network baseline.
The official Prosperity Stats/output organization is source-pinned, including the bit-to-byte conversion boundary.

findings.finding: The registry is intentionally incomplete for a paper system table: no row closes common-resource decoder-complete cycles, memory energy, macro area, and valid825 hardware accuracy.
findings.disposition: KEEP_BLOCKED until an executable full-network adapter and common memory/PPA model exist.

findings.finding: Official Prosperity source paths are pinned to the current local artifact root, so cross-host replay requires the same path or a future path-remapping contract.
findings.disposition: Accept for this host-local evidence registry; add path remapping only when packaging for another server.

findings.finding: Current tests exercise source SHA, pointer, row population, duplicate metric, non-finite JSON, null reason, and provenance attacks, but do not invoke the CLI in a separate tampered-contract test.
findings.disposition: Low risk because the canonical CLI run verified builder/config/test/docs359 pins and the generated output is sealed.

decision: M520 is ready as a fail-closed evidence registry and gap list. It is explicitly not ready as the DATE system comparison table and admits no system speedup.
